info.title: ids-tool
info.description: A command line tool to audit IDS (Information Delivery Specification) files from buildingSMART.

commands.name: audit
commands.description: Audits ids files and/or their xsd schema.

options.name: --xsd
options.description: XSD schema(s) to load, this is useful when testing changes in the schema (e.g. GitHub repo). If this is not specified, an embedded schema is adopted depending on the each ids's declaration of version.

options.name: --schema
options.description: Check validity of the xsd schema(s) passed with the `xsd` option. This is useful for the development of the schema and it is in use in the official repository for quality assurance purposes. [default: False]

options.name: --extension
options.description: When passing a folder as source, this defines which files to audit by extension. [default: ids]

options.name: --omitContent
options.description: Skips the audit of the agreed limitation of IDS contents.

options.name: --omitContentAuditPattern
options.description: Regex applied to file name to omit the audit of the semantic aspects of the IDS.

arguments.name: SOURCE
arguments.description: Input IDS to be processed; it can be a file or a folder.

commands.name: errorcode
commands.description: provides description of tool's error code, useful when providing useer feedback in batch commands.

arguments.name: REQUESTEDCODE
arguments.description: the error code number to describe.
